items.title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,950 over past day

items.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with Iskander, Kalibr and Kh-22/32 missiles and over 300 drones: air defences downs 293 aerial assets

items.title: Russian missile strikes injure 15 people in Kharkiv

items.title: Russians attack Pokrovsk and two other fronts over 70 times – Ukraine's General Staff

items.title: Closing loopholes: Council lists individuals and entities for circumventing EU sanctions
items.teaser: The Council has adopted restrictive measures against three individuals and nine entities involved in the import of sanctioned goods to Russia, and in the circumvention of sanctions related to oil and financial transactions.

items.title: German expert: Europe must stand up to Trump and continue supporting Ukraine and Zelensky
items.teaser: European countries should clearly state their readiness to continue supporting Ukraine and its elected President Volodymyr Zelensky, even if this means openly disagreeing with U.S. President Donald Trump.

items.title: Russian large-scale attack on Kharkiv: number of people injured rises to 15 – photos

items.title: Russian attack leaves Vinnytsia without power
items.teaser: Vinnytsia Mayor Serhii Morhunov says the damage is being assessed following Russian strikes. Critical infrastructure is operating on backup power and additional buses and minibuses will replace electric public transport.

items.teaser: French President Emmanuel Macron criticized far-right leader Marine Le Pen’s statements that she intends to end financial support for Ukraine if she comes to power, stressing that assisting Kyiv serves France’s national interests and that abandoning such support would mean neglecting the security of the French people a

items.title: Russians strike Sumy again as rescuers respond to first attack

items.title: Five Ukrainian films make European Film Awards shortlists

items.teaser: Vor einigen Wochen haben wir bereits per Newsletter über den Start der Umfragen zur Evaluation der EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung informiert. Da der Start der Umfragen ausgerechnet in die Ferienzeit fiel, möchten wir Sie hiermit erneut an die Umfragen erinnern.

items.title: Förderkompass 2026
items.teaser: Schnell zur passenden Förderung – erstmals ausschließlich digital verfügbar.

items.title: Exportkontrolle Aktuell Juli 2026
Evaluation der EU-Dual-Use-VO
items.teaser: Wie in den vergangenen Monaten bereits angekündigt, hat die EU-Kommission den in Art. 26 Abs. 4 der Verordnung (EU) 2021/821 (EU-Dual-Use-VO) vorgesehenen Prozess zur Evaluation gestartet.

items.title: FM Sybiha: Ukraine plans to buy weapons from Poland by year-end using EUR 125M loan
items.teaser: Ukraine expects to finalize an agreement with Poland by the end of the year on a €125 million loan for the purchase of Polish weapons. Ukraine is also ready to conclude a “Drone Deal” with Poland and cooperate on the joint production of weapons under the SAFE program.

items.title: Wegen Mitteilung: AfD-Landtagspräsident Tobias Rausch gesteht Fehler ein
items.teaser: Eine Mitteilung des Landtags von Sachsen-Anhalt zum Gedenken an den Anschlag von Halle war fast wortgleich mit einer Erklärung der AfD-Fraktion. Landtagspräsident Rausch räumt den Fehler ein und muss dem Ältestenrat Rede und Antwort stehen.

items.title: Fünf Verletzte in Uman durch Absturz russischer Drohne auf Wohnhochhaus
items.teaser: In der Stadt Uman ist durch den Absturz einer russischer Drohne ein Brand in einem Wohnhochhaus ausgebrochen. Fünf Menschen wurden verletzt, teilt der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung Ihor Taburez, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Emergency power cuts introduced in Kyiv
items.teaser: DTEK says emergency power cuts are in force in Kyiv following a Russian attack on energy facilities. Rolling power outage schedules do not apply during emergency power cuts

items.title: Trump says Ukraine has "plenty of targets" in Russia beyond oil refineries
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump has stated that Russia has "plenty of targets" besides oil refineries that Ukraine could strike, calling the campaign against Russian refineries a disgrace

items.title: Bei Militärübung filmen China-Mietwagen heimlich norwegische Soldaten – Spionageverdacht sorgt in Norwegen für Aufregung
items.teaser: Vernetzte Autos sammeln weit mehr Daten als viele Fahrer ahnen. In Norwegen gerieten nun sogar Soldaten und Zugangscodes in den Speicher von Mietwagen.

items.title: Zelensky meets Danish PM to discuss air defense and financial stability
items.teaser: In Brussels, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky held a meeting with Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen.

items.title: Russian drone attack leaves Lutsk without electricity
items.teaser: Lutsk lost electricity supply on 16 October following a Russian drone attack. Municipal services are operating on backup power, residents are urged to shelter during air-raid warnings and follow official updates.

items.title: FM Sybiha: Ukraine receives confirmation of new aid packages from at least five countries
items.teaser: Ukraine has received confirmation of new energy, humanitarian, and defense aid packages from at least five partner countries.

items.title: Investigation: How scammers exploit Ukraine’s occupation to deceive foreign men
items.teaser: He believed his online date was trapped under Russian occupation. She may never have existed.

items.title: Vorankündigung des 18. Informationstags Exportkontrolle
items.teaser: Der Informationstag Exportkontrolle (ITE) wird am 10. Dezember 2026 in Frankfurt am Main stattfinden.

items.title: 20. Exportkontrolltag in Berlin eröffnet
items.teaser: Der 20. Exportkontrolltag ist heute in Berlin eröffnet worden. Unter dem Leitthema „Exportkontrolle in der Balance?“ diskutieren heute und morgen Vertreterinnen und Vertreter aus Politik, Verwaltung, Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft und internationalen Partnerorganisationen aktuelle Entwicklungen der Exportkontrolle.

Zelensky and Belgian PM discuss additional F-16 fighter jet and ammunition deliveries
items.teaser: Zelensky and the Belgian Prime Minister discussed additional deliveries of F-16 fighter jets and ammunition for them, as well as protection against Russian attacks.

items.title: Russia loses 1,790 soldiers and 693 drones over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 1,790 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day

items.title: 20. Exportkontrolltag – Anmeldestart
items.teaser: Die Anmeldung zum Exportkontrolltag ist ab sofort möglich.

items.title: Russian drone falls on high-rise block in Uman, injuring five people
items.teaser: Five people were injured in Uman after a Russian drone fell on a high-rise residential building on the morning of 16 October. A separate fire broke out at a business in Cherkasy, but no casualties were reported there.

items.title: Order limiting Starlink access for Ukraine's military came from within White House, Reuters reports
items.teaser: Starlink, implemented speed restrictions on Oct. 14 without warning, limiting speed to 100 miles per hour (160 kilometers per hour). The unexpected restriction disrupted active military operations, including the use of mid-range strike and interceptor drones.

items.title: Defense Forces strike Russian Irbis mobile radar station
items.teaser: Fighters from the “Predator” Brigade of the Patrol Police Department struck a Russian invaders’ “Irbis” mobile radar station—worth millions of dollars—with attack drones.

items.title: Twenty-two US lawmakers demand Trump immediately impose Russia sanctions under Graham Act
items.teaser: Twenty-two Democratic and Republican members of the US House of Representatives have called on President Donald Trump to fully implement the sanctions against Russia provided for under Senator Lindsey Graham's act by 18 October

items.title: Russian drone attack sparks fire at oil depot in Khmelnytskyi region's Shepetivka district
items.teaser: A fire broke out as a result of a drone attack on an oil depot in the Shepetivka district of Khmelnytskyi region.

items.title: Stegner: "AfD und BSW sind nicht für Frieden"
items.teaser: Bei "illner" treffen schwarz-rote Positionen im Umgang mit dem Ukraine-Krieg auf BSW-Politikerin Claudia Wittig. Ralf Stegner warnt vor Kräften, die "nicht für Frieden" seien.

items.title: US lifts some sanctions restrictions on overseas assets of Russia's Lukoil
items.teaser: The US Treasury has renewed authorisations covering Russian oil giant Lukoil's foreign petrol stations and four subsidiaries in Bulgaria. The exemptions allow certain business operations to continue but prohibit transfers of funds to Russia.

items.title: Man injured in Russian attack on enterprise in Derhachi dies in hospital
items.teaser: A man who suffered severe burns in a Russian strike on an enterprise in Derhachi, Kharkiv region, has died in hospital.

items.title: Ukraine's Patriot interceptor stocks again reach critically low levels, media reports
items.teaser: Ukraine's supply of Patriot interceptor missiles has reached a critical low, multiple media outlets reported on Oct. 15 citing Ukrainian officials, as Russia intensifies attacks on energy infrastructure ahead of the upcoming winter months.

items.title: Ukraine has run out of missiles for Patriot air defence systems – WP
items.teaser: Ukrainian officials tell The Washington Post that supplies of Patriot interceptors have dwindled amid intensified Russian strikes. Irregular deliveries and global demand for air defence missiles are adding to the pressure on Ukraine's defences.

items.title: Drone enters Moldova again during Russian attack on Ukraine
items.teaser: On the night of October 15, an unidentified unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) violated Moldova's airspace amid another wave of massive Russian aerial attacks on Ukraine.

items.title: "He doesn't want to settle": Trump says he does not want to deal with Zelenskyy
items.teaser: In an interview with Newsmax, US President Donald Trump accuses Volodymyr Zelenskyy of being unwilling to negotiate with Moscow, criticises Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil refineries and describes Russia's failed 2022 advance on Kyiv as partly down to the weather.

items.title: Starlink-Störung in der Ukraine: Enttäuscht von Musk, enttäuscht von Trump
items.teaser: In der Ukraine scheint für viele klar: Die Starlink-Ausfälle sind kein Zufall, sondern politisch gewollt. Die Unterstützung aus der EU wird immer wichtiger. Von Rebecca Barth, ARD-Studio Kiew.

items.title: 'I'm not a big fan of Zelensky,' Trump says as US-Ukraine tensions deepen
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump criticized President Volodymyr Zelensky in an interview with Newsmax published on Oct. 15, describing the Ukrainian president as "not a good guy for (the U.S.) to deal with."

items.title: 20. Exportkontrolltag – Anmeldestart am 15. April 2026

items.title: Ukraine destroys Russian drone operator training center in occupied Kherson region
items.teaser: Ukrainian troops have destroyed a training center for drone operators belonging to Russia’s 18th Army in the occupied part of the Kherson region.

items.title: Ukrainian drones reportedly strike Yandex data center, warehouses in overnight attack on Russia
items.teaser: According to monitoring channels ExileNova+ and SuperNova+, Russian technology giant Yandex's data center in Vladimir Oblast, around 500 kilometers (310 miles) from the Ukrainian border, was targeted in the overnight operation.

items.title: White House ordered restrictions on Starshield in Ukraine – Reuters
items.teaser: Ukrainian officials say limits on SpaceX's government satellite communications system have disrupted drone interception and military operations. The White House has denied that Donald Trump requested the restrictions.

items.title: WTO and multilateral partners review progress on supply chain finance initiative
items.teaser: Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala joined leaders of multilateral development banks and other international organizations at a high-level roundtable held on the sidelines of the 2026 World Bank – International Monetary Fund (IMF) Annual Meetings in Bangkok, Thailand, on 16 October to review progress in expanding supp

items.title: Ukraine to raise €60 mln from EIB for border infrastructure development
items.teaser: The Cabinet of Ministers has approved the attraction of a €60 million loan from the European Investment Bank (EIB) to implement the Ukraine Western Border Infrastructure project.

items.title: Airspace closed across much of European Russia amid large-scale drone attack
items.teaser: A large-scale drone attack has led to widespread airspace restrictions across central and western Russia, with all four Moscow airports suspending operations. Russian authorities have also reported drone activity in several other oblasts.

items.title: Zaporizhzhia diocese of Moscow-linked Ukrainian Orthodox Church recognized as affiliated with ROC
items.teaser: Ukraine’s State Service for Ethnopolitics and Freedom of Conscience has recognized the Administration of the Zaporizhzhia Diocese of the Ukrainian Orthodox Church of the Moscow Patriarchate as affiliated with the Russian Orthodox Church (ROC).

items.title: Black Sea grain war escalates: Ukraine knocked out most of Russia’s grain exports, and Russia is now sinking ships off Romania and Bulgaria
items.teaser: Turkey and the UN are pushing for a Black Sea truce, but Putin has rejected a pause in strikes.

items.title: Putin orders seizure of Tarkett and four other European companies' Russian assets
items.teaser: A decree signed by Vladimir Putin places Russian assets belonging to five European businesses under the control of a Russian management company. The move affects companies in flooring, paper packaging, hygiene products and metal packaging, amid a wider Kremlin campaign targeting foreign-owned businesses

items.title: G7 countries pledge 260 million euros to repair Chornobyl safety infrastructure damaged in Russian attack
items.teaser: The confinement structure, located about 130 kilometers (80 miles) north of Kyiv, was severely damaged in February 2025 after being struck by a Russian drone.

items.title: Wie schwer trifft eine Starlink-Drosselung die Ukraine?
items.teaser: Ohne Starlink könne es "sehr, sehr gefährlich" werden: Warum das Satellitennetzwerk für die Ukraine unverzichtbar ist, erklärt Oberst Reisner im Interview.

items.title: Ausfuhrkontrolle: Bundesregierung vereinfacht Ausfuhr von bestimmten Rüstungsgütern an die Golfstaaten und die Ukraine
items.teaser: Die befristete Allgemeine Genehmigung für die Lieferung von Gütern der Luft- und maritimen Verteidigung ist zum 20. März 2026 in Kraft getreten.

items.title: Anpassung der Muster zu Endverbleibserklärungen für Ausfuhren nach Russland
items.teaser: Die Muster zu Endverbleibserklärungen für unmittelbare und mittelbare Ausfuhren nach Russland (Anlagen C 6 und C 7) wurden aktualisiert und sind ab sofort auf der BAFA-Internetseite abrufbar.

items.title: 20. Exportkontrolltag – Save The Date
items.teaser: Der 20. Exportkontrolltag findet im Juni in Berlin statt.

items.title: US considering easing sanctions on shadow fleet – Reuters
items.teaser: The Trump administration is considering easing sanctions on the so-called shadow fleet – vessels transporting oil and petroleum products from Russia, Iran and Venezuela – in an effort to bring down record-high global freight rates.

items.title: Zelenskyy announces new packages to strengthen Ukraine's combat aviation after meeting Macron
items.teaser: Following talks with French President Emmanuel Macron, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has announced that Ukraine will receive new aid packages to strengthen its combat aviation this month

items.title: Zelensky meets Belgian Prime Minister De Wever, but silence reigns on Russian assets
items.teaser: The talks apparently failed to yield a breakthrough on the fate of €200 billion ($227 billion) in Russian assets frozen by Euroclear under Belgian jurisdiction.

items.title: Zelensky, Macron discuss ways to counter Russian air attacks
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and French President Emmanuel Macron discussed ways to counter Russian air attacks and accelerate the development of a European anti-ballistic missile system.

items.title: Russian forces attack oil depot in Khmelnytskyi Oblast
items.teaser: Russian forces struck an oil depot in the Shepetivka district on 15 October, sparking a fire. Khmelnytskyi Oblast Military Administration says air defence units were responding during repeated drone attacks on the oblast.

items.title: Ukraine’s military now orders supplies based on real front-line data, not guesswork, lawmaker says. Shift comes under new commander-in-chief
items.teaser: Ukraine’s new commander-in-chief, Drapatyi, is centering the army on soldiers’ lives and real front-line needs, a lawmaker believes.

items.title: Zelensky: 52 people wounded in Russian attacks across Ukraine in single day
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky discussed threats to Ukraine and ways to strengthen its defenses against Russian attacks during a meeting with Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk in Brussels. He also reported that 52 people had been wounded across Ukraine on October 15 alone.

items.title: Russian drone strikes leave portions of Kyiv without power, fires burning
items.teaser: Damage to energy facilities in the Kyiv region has also reduced water pressure in areas of the capital on the Dnipro River's right bank. Emergency specialists are switching power supplies to water pumping stations, Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said.

items.title: Posting strike videos online may help Russia tune its drones’ optical targeting. Moscow now pays people to film hits, Ukrainian adviser warns
items.teaser: Russia is collecting footage of its Geran attack drones hitting Ukraine, probably to test the optical target-recognition systems that guide them in their final seconds.

items.title: Zwei Spione des Irans in Hamburg verurteilt
items.teaser: Die Männer sollen antisemitische Anschläge in Deutschland vorbereitet haben. Unter anderem auf Volker Beck.

items.title: Exportkontrolle Aktuell – Sonder-Newsletter
Ukraine’s first use of FP-7 ballistic missile successful, military expert says
items.teaser: Ukraine has used its domestically developed FP-7 ballistic missile against targets on Russian territory for the first time. The strike was successful, as Russian S-400 systems failed to intercept the missile.

items.title: Ukraine’s shell factories outpace state orders, arms company chief says: Kyiv spent five months buying from them this year, leaving six to produce
items.teaser: Private plants were built under Russian fire with no state investment, says the head of Ukrainian defense maker Ukrainian Armor

items.title: Tusk assures Zelensky of Poland’s support for Ukraine
items.teaser: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has reaffirmed Poland’s support and solidarity with Ukraine following talks with European leaders in Brussels.

items.title: Russische Angriffe auf Kraftwerke: Was die Ukraine im Winter erwartet
items.teaser: Die Städte der Ukraine bereiten sich unter massiven Angriffen Russlands auf die Energieinfrastruktur auf die bevorstehende Heizperiode vor. Welche Probleme drohen den Ukrainern im kommenden Winter?

items.title: UK to resupply Ukraine with more Storm Shadow missiles to strike Russia, Bloomberg reports
items.teaser: In a meeting in London on Oct. 14, President Volodymyr Zelensky and U.K. Prime Minister Andy Burnham agreed on a new shipment of missiles, Bloomberg reported, citing people familiar with the matter. No official public announcement of this resupply has been made.

items.title: Ukraine deposits seed samples in Svalbard Global Seed Vault
items.teaser: Ukraine has deposited seed samples from its national collection in the Global Seed Vault on the Svalbard archipelago in Norway, an international reserve for preserving plant genetic resources.

items.title: PM Koretskyi: Ukraine meets all deadlines to secure 2026 international aid
items.teaser: The government has fulfilled all its planned commitments to international partners on time to secure financial assistance in 2026.

items.title: Barrot says Europeans provide two-thirds of intelligence to Ukraine
items.teaser: European countries, including France, currently provide two-thirds of the intelligence Ukraine receives from its partners.

items.title: Litauen friert Vermögenswerte russischer Oligarchen Fridman und Usmanow ein
items.teaser: Litauen hat im Rahmen seines nationalen Sanktionssystems Vermögenswerte der russischen Oligarchen Michail Fridman und Alischer Usmanow eingefroren.

items.title: NYT: Russia intends to cut off Kyiv, Kharkiv and Odesa from power, water and heating in one month
items.teaser: Russia has prepared a plan to disable Ukraine's energy system in one month, cutting off Kyiv, Kharkiv and Odesa from power, water and heating supplies, The New York Times reports.

items.title: CNN reports Ukraine has run out of Patriot missiles
items.teaser: Ukraine has run out of interceptor missiles for its US-made Patriot air defence systems, leaving the country more vulnerable to Russian ballistic attacks.
